# Broadcastwell

> Broadcastwell is an AI search visibility agency for vertical B2B software companies. We measure how often AI engines name a vendor in buyer answers, then build the third-party evidence those answers cite.

## Current prices and terms (26 Sep 2026)

This block supersedes any older price or availability line, here or elsewhere. Legal master: https://broadcastwell.com/terms. Price ladder: https://broadcastwell.com/pricing.

- Category Audit: $490 once. Open. One category, ten buyer questions, five engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode), three measured runs, 150 planned observations. Findings within 48 hours of category confirmation. The full $490 credits against the Diagnostic within 30 days. Buy it at https://broadcastwell.com/buy/audit
- AI Visibility Diagnostic: $990 once. Paused; it reopens after our next Audit delivery. 35 buyer questions, five engines, 525 scheduled observed answers, adaptive runs extra. Start with the $490 Category Audit, which credits in full within 30 days.
- Fix Sprint: $2,900 once, 30 days, available after a completed Diagnostic. https://broadcastwell.com/fix-sprint
- The program: $13,500 per 90 days, billed $4,500 monthly. Booked by a call: https://broadcastwell.com/contact
- Agency wholesale: $1,000 per client per month for the first client and $490 per client per month for each additional client. A single white-label Category Audit for an agency client is $490 per report. https://broadcastwell.com/for-agencies
- Refund: a standalone Category Audit or AI Visibility Diagnostic is refundable in full, no questions asked, if requested within 30 days of delivery of the findings.
- Free 10-question check (one engine): ten buyer questions on Perplexity, no email needed. https://audit.broadcastwell.com
- The Category Audit, the Diagnostic and the Fix Sprint are one-time prices with no annual contract.

Free 10-question check (one engine): ten buyer questions for your category. No email is needed. https://audit.broadcastwell.com
Category Audit: $490 once. One category, ten buyer questions, five engines, three measured runs. Who is named instead of you with counts, which of the ten questions you lose, the sources cited in those answers, a crawler access check, three prioritized fixes, receipts, a CMO summary and a finance memo. Findings within 48 hours of category confirmation. The full $490 is credited against the Diagnostic if the Diagnostic is bought within 30 days. Buy it at https://broadcastwell.com/buy/audit
AI Visibility Diagnostic: 35 category-defining buyer questions across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode, with three scheduled runs per question and engine and up to two further runs on any pair whose verdicts disagreed: 525 scheduled observed answers, named and cited outcomes reported separately with numerator, denominator and a 95 percent confidence interval, competitor and source analysis, limitations, run-to-run spread, a receipts appendix, machine-readable data files, and a prioritized evidence, content and distribution plan. $990 once. The full $990 Diagnostic fee credits against the Fix Sprint or the program's first invoice, once, and not both. The Sprint fee does not credit against the program. Paused; it reopens after our next Audit delivery. https://broadcastwell.com/ai-visibility-audit
Fix Sprint: $2,900 over 30 days, following a completed AI Visibility Diagnostic. An entity and structured data pass, up to five answer pages or rewrites, a source plan with a prepared submission or correction pack for up to ten third-party sources, a crawler access check, and a day 30 re-measure on the fixed question set. For Fix Sprints ordered on or after 26 Sep 2026: at day 30 we re-run your target questions on all five engines, three runs each, and if your named count has not risen beyond the run-to-run noise we measured at baseline, we refund the full $2,900, including the $990 Diagnostic credit, within five business days, without you asking. https://broadcastwell.com/fix-sprint
The Program: $13,500 per 90 days, billed $4,500 monthly, with a 90 day initial term, then month to month. Booked by a call. Client stories are published only with explicit approval; reviews are optional and never required or incentivized.
Agency Wholesale: $1,000 per client per month for the first client and $490 per client per month for each additional client. Per client, per month, under the agency name: the fixed question set re-measured on five engines with three runs each, a written client-facing findings report naming who is named instead of the client and the sources visible in those answers, the fixes stated as which page to update and which publisher to get in front of, reported by question type, and crawler access checked. A single white-label Category Audit for an agency client is $490 per report. No minimum. Monthly term. Details at https://broadcastwell.com/for-agencies
The Absence Manual, free and ungated, 13 chapters and 5 appendices: https://docs.broadcastwell.com/ (PDF: https://docs.broadcastwell.com/absence-manual.pdf)
Reporting cadence: brand mentions, citations and the sources engines pull from are reported every month. The 35 question re-score across five engines runs every quarter, because one run is not a trend and a monthly headline score cannot separate signal from run-to-run variance. Month one is a baseline, not a verdict.
90-day proof gate: At the day-90 re-score, the named count must be strictly greater than baseline on the same agreed questions, engines and method version. A tie fails. If the gate is not met, Broadcastwell does not invoice month four and you may end the engagement with no further charge. Under the current terms, v1.1 covers all 35 agreed questions across five engines. The panel is frozen, each question-and-engine cell counts once, and cells lost to engine errors are excluded from both sides and reported. Except under the refund clause, months one to three are not refundable. No inclusion, ranking, revenue or commercial result is guaranteed. The baseline is the first Diagnostic run under the method version named in the contract. For v1.1, the frozen 35-question panel has 175 question-and-engine cells, including 50 cells for the ten shortlist questions. The same questions, five engines and method version are used at baseline and the day-90 re-score. Each cell uses the verdict defined by the method: unanimous across the three scheduled runs, or the majority after adaptive reruns. Extra adaptive answers never inflate the cell count. Cells lost to engine errors are excluded from both comparisons, with the common denominator and exclusions reported. Named means named; tone is not scored. Question groups are reported separately. You retain all runs, answers, citations and sources. Engagements under an earlier method remain on their agreed version.
Refunds, offer by offer: Refund terms depend on the offer. A standalone Category Audit or AI Visibility Diagnostic is refundable in full, no questions asked, if requested within 30 days of delivery of the findings. The first month of the program is refundable in full, no questions asked, at any time before month two is invoiced. You do not need to give a reason, and you keep every deliverable produced up to that point. The only exception is third-party costs paid on your behalf, and we tell you about any of those before they are incurred.
Receipts on every answer: every observed answer is delivered to the client in full, with the engine that returned it, the date and time it ran, and every source it cited, wins and losses alike. No figure is reported that cannot be traced back to the answers underneath it.
Prompt classes are never blended: no question in the Diagnostic names any brand, whether the client or a competitor. The 35 generic buyer questions are grouped into ten shortlist, ten buyer role, ten use case and five evaluation questions. Any separate branded comparison is reported separately and never folded into the headline.
Your data leaves with you: the question set, citation logs, observed answers and reports belong to the client, returned in an open, machine-readable format within five business days of the request and at no charge if the engagement ends, for any reason.
The published account: where a reduced rate is agreed it is a trade rather than a discount, exchanged for a published account of the work stating what was measured, what was changed and what moved. Published only with the client's explicit written approval.

## Offer record, corrected 26 September 2026

Authoritative current offer record: https://broadcastwell.com/company-facts. Legal master: https://broadcastwell.com/terms.

Agency wholesale worked totals: one client $1,000 a month, three clients $1,980 a month, five clients $2,960 a month; each additional client $490 per month.

Partner Network: $225 per paid Diagnostic referral; 10% of collected program revenue for up to 12 paid months. No commission on the $490 Category Audit. A referred buyer who starts at the Category Audit and upgrades within 30 days earns the partner the Diagnostic commission.

Method v1.1: Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode. 525 scheduled observed answers; adaptive observations are extra and reported separately. AI answers vary, so repeated observations and disagreements are retained. Presence is measured, tone is not. The headline comparison uses the scheduled fixed panel.

Other approved client references: Neurvalis, Diagnostic then program, engagement facts only; Valren Atelier, online-first leather-goods brand, baseline AI visibility audit and strategic guidance, no performance claim, external link https://instagram.com/valrenatelier.

Current public proof: three published research papers with DOIs, the fictional Kalvenor SAMPLE DATA at https://app.broadcastwell.com/sample, and the API and fifteen-tool connector for Claude and ChatGPT at https://app.broadcastwell.com/developers. The claimable Absence Index, badges and dispute log are at https://index.broadcastwell.com. Its current data release is 2026-09, published 23 Sep 2026: 286 vendors, 14 categories, 2,095 valid target answers, method v1.1, DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22907695. The August release 2026-08.1 (DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22721962) is historical. Historical research engine counts remain those actually measured.

Broadcastwell is a founder-led team of consultants and engineers. Sairam Sivakumar, Founder, is accountable for every order.

## Agency studies

- [Omniscient Digital Alternatives, Measured and Dated](https://broadcastwell.com/omniscient-digital-alternatives): We scored 200 AI answers across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. Omniscient Digital was named 49 times, Hamster Garage 19, Minuttia 15, Rampiq 14 and Zupo 13.
- [Minuttia Alternatives, Measured and Dated](https://broadcastwell.com/minuttia-alternatives): July 2026: Minuttia named in 15 of 200 answers and 1 of 120 name-free answers; minuttia.com cited 24 times. ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, five runs each.
- [Hamster Garage vs Rampiq, Measured and Dated](https://broadcastwell.com/hamster-garage-vs-rampiq): July 2026: Hamster Garage named 3 times, Rampiq 0, in 120 name-free answers; rampiq.agency cited 25 times. ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, five runs each.
- [Zupo vs Omniscient Digital, Measured and Dated](https://broadcastwell.com/zupo-vs-omniscient-digital): July 2026: Omniscient Digital named 15 times, Zupo 0, in 120 name-free answers; zupo.co cited 19 times. ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, five runs each.
- [Which Agencies AI Engines Name: 200 Answers, July 2026](https://broadcastwell.com/chatgpt-perplexity-visibility-agencies): July 2026: 200 answers across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, five runs. Five agencies received 19 mentions in 120 name-free answers; one firm received 15.
- [Which Type of Agency to Hire for LLM Search Visibility](https://broadcastwell.com/which-agency-for-llm-search-visibility): Compare four kinds of LLM search visibility agency and the work each does, using a 200-answer study on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews to explain measurement.

- [Healthcare RCM Software: AI Search Visibility Measured | Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/ai-search-visibility-healthcare-rcm-software): A 37-answer sweep of healthcare RCM software on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. Waystar was named 20 times, R1 RCM 12, and 13 answers named no vendor at all.
- [Legal Practice Management Software: AI Search Visibility Measured | Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/ai-search-visibility-legal-practice-software): 39 answers on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews: Clio named 31 times. ChatGPT used one vendor's retired 2023 product identity five times.
- [Radiology and Imaging Software: AI Search Visibility Measured | Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/ai-search-visibility-radiology-imaging-software): An 80-answer sweep of radiology and imaging software on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews returned 622 citations across 187 domains. 94 domains were cited exactly once and KLAS took 9.
